Box-and-whisker statistics with whiskers at chosen quantiles

calibration_box_stats.Rd

The quartiles and median for the box, and whiskers at the whiskers quantiles rather than at 1.5 times the interquartile range, so that a whisker can mark the range a calibration check uses (its 5th and 95th percentiles, say).

Usage

calibration_box_stats(x, whiskers = c(0.05, 0.95))

Arguments

x

Numeric. Non-finite values are dropped.

whiskers

The quantiles the whiskers reach: two probabilities, the lower at most 0.25 and the upper at least 0.75.

Value

A list: stats, a one-row data frame with ymin, lower, middle, upper and ymax (the names ggplot2::geom_boxplot(stat = "identity") takes), and out, the values beyond the whiskers.

Details

All five values are stats::quantile() type 7: INTERPOLATED quantiles, not order statistics. With 40 values the 5th percentile falls between the second and third smallest, so a check defined as "the second lowest replicate" will not match the lower whisker exactly.

See also

Other calibration plots: calibration_events(), calibration_plot_palette(), plot_calibration_area_by_fuel(), plot_calibration_convergence(), plot_calibration_fire_counts(), plot_calibration_fire_sizes(), plot_calibration_groups(), plot_calibration_loss(), plot_calibration_replicates(), plot_calibration_severity(), plot_calibration_severity_by_size(), plot_fire_regime_multipliers(), replicate_percentile()

Examples

calibration_box_stats(1:20, whiskers = c(0.1, 0.9))
#> $stats
#>   ymin lower middle upper ymax
#> 1  2.9  5.75   10.5 15.25 18.1
#> 
#> $out
#> [1]  1  2 19 20
#>
